get_kitti_image_info: build a python module to load KITTI dataset image info with calibration and label annotations for training
get_waymo_image_info: build a python module to load Waymo dataset image info with multi-sweep point clouds and pose data
get_label_anno: create a function that parses a KITTI label file and returns annotations as numpy arrays
kitti_anno_to_label_file: create a function that writes KITTI annotation dictionaries to label text files in a folder
kitti_result_line: create a function that formats a result dictionary into a KITTI label file line string
